comment: Benign windows left out of DC-era training for exp16-ws0 (ws-etw-0), range 2026-11-09T16:49Z -> now. UTC. ws-etw-0 was promoted to Primary Domain Controller of nt2102.lab at 2026-11-09T10:41:41Z (ntds.dit CreationTimeUtc); exp10 trained on idle ending 11-09T10:25Z, 16 min before, so it is blind to the DC role. This range starts at the first clean dos-map run AFTER the promotion/reboot churn (live-20261109T164916Z, 16:49Z), which sidesteps the one-time 10:45Z dcpromo/role-install/reboot burst (60k kproc in 15 min, settled by ~11:15Z) entirely, so no promotion entry is needed. By user decision (2026-11-12) the benign set INCLUDES all DC automated work (ADWS/DFSR/DNS/NTDS, replication, OS jobs) AND admin RDP/console sessions (e.g. the 11-10 16:20Z rdpclip SessionID=2 session is kept) -- a D2 variant, so no detection is claimed for an admin-looking attacker on ws-etw-0. Only our rotation canaries and one attack burst are excluded. Found by scanning kproc ProcessStart (ImageName/SessionID) + etw-meta in Loki. See docs/notes/ws-etw-1-retrain-20261111.md and docs/notes/training-runbook.md.
